svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 59.3B tokens, 93.5% cache hit, $57,416.93 estimated cost, peak 5.8B on 06-06. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
